title: Calendar and Task Systems
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting calendar and task systems to one-week calendar and task plan, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.

learning_objectives.statement: Separate fixed-time events (which belong on a calendar) from deadline-bound work (which belongs on a task list)
Schedule a work block for each task before its deadline, so the work has a reserved time and not just a due time
Set reminder lead times that account for travel and setup, not just the moment the event starts
Track task state (not started, in progress, done) so the list shows what is left, not just what exists

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
